answer: Work-slot deposit burn: an agent that wants a paid slot locks a deposit and registers its kernel identity at one vertex of the referral graph, marked by a marble anyone can see. Each slot costs 40 POA, burned when it closes, so 100 fake identities cost 4,000 POA for slots that earn nothing, while an honest agent pays once and keeps the slot income. A slot idle for 20 epochs is reclaimed, so hoarded identities bleed value instead of multiplying.
